title: Revenue operations & sales analytics
description: Salesforce revenue operations portfolio with sales, pipeline, quality, compensation scenarios and evidence-backed operational insights.

source.label: Maven Analytics CRM Sales Opportunities — public fictional sample

evidenceFlow.title: Download source CSVs
evidenceFlow.detail: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZeinabBagherifard/CRM-Sales-Opportunities/master/; download only the five CSVs; exact SHA-256 checks are in python/maven_data.py

evidenceFlow.title: Validate and join
evidenceFlow.detail: python python/pipeline.py; unique IDs, agent/account/product relationships, closed-deal values and date ordering; preserve open-deal nulls; normalize GTXPro to GTX Pro

metricDefinitions.label: Won revenue
metricDefinitions.definition: Sum of source close_value for Won deals, all closing in 2017. Dollar display is a portfolio currency convention; source does not specify a currency code.

metricDefinitions.label: Open opportunities
metricDefinitions.definition: Count of Engaging and Prospecting rows. Open amounts and expected close dates are absent; no monetary pipeline estimate.

metricDefinitions.label: Win rate
metricDefinitions.definition: Won / (Won + Lost), excluding all open deals.

metricDefinitions.label: Average engagement-to-close
metricDefinitions.definition: Mean close_date minus engage_date for Won deals, in calendar days. Not creation-to-close.

source.label: Portfolio compensation scenario applied to Maven won values

evidenceFlow.title: Download source CSVs
evidenceFlow.detail: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ZeinabBagherifard/CRM-Sales-Opportunities/master/; download only the five CSVs; exact SHA-256 checks are in python/maven_data.py

evidenceFlow.title: Validate and join
evidenceFlow.detail: python python/pipeline.py; unique IDs, agent/account/product relationships, closed-deal values and date ordering; preserve open-deal nulls; normalize GTXPro to GTX Pro

metricDefinitions.label: Scenario attainment
metricDefinitions.definition: 2017 won value / assumed $500,000 annual target per each of 35 listed agents; no quotas are supplied by the dataset.

metricDefinitions.label: Estimated payout
metricDefinitions.definition: 5% of source Won close_value. Portfolio scenario, not actual compensation.

rows.title: Opportunity hygiene before the weekly forecast
rows.body: Confirm account, owner, product, stage, amount, currency and expected close date. Preserve unknown values rather than entering zero. Open Maven deals lack amounts and expected close dates: report their count, and resolve source gaps before valuing pipeline.

checklist: Assign next steps without sending messages

rows.title: Revenue reporting and Looker definitions
rows.body: Won revenue is the sum of Closed Won deal value, not accounting revenue. Win rate is won divided by all closed deals. Open deals are excluded from win rate. The 2017 Maven sample has no currency code; the displayed dollars are a convention. Looker and Power BI must reconcile to 10,005,534 won value and 4,238 won deals on the full sample.
checklist: Record the native report run ID

rows.title: New business-line onboarding
rows.body: Agree account and owner crosswalks before migration. Prefix legacy IDs with the business line. Map stages to the existing lifecycle, preserve explicit currency and require real close dates. Resolve every rejected record before an export is migration-ready. Compare counts and currency-specific sums; never combine currencies without an approved FX policy.

rows.title: Commission review and payout controls
rows.body: The bundled plan is a flat 5% scenario. Round each representative payout to cents before summing. Review the basis, rate, adjustments and period before approval. Approval rehearsal is separate from payment; this application has no bank or payroll connector. Real payout processing requires the company plan, segregation of duties and secure finance evidence.

rows.title: Automation incident and retry review
rows.body: Use the same stable event ID across retries. Same ID and same payload return the prior result; a changed payload under the same ID is rejected. Validate currency before threshold checks. Keep API tokens in private credential stores. A queued backend outbox is not evidence that a Zap ran or that a message was delivered.
